card: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to eliminate eleven live mutants identified by automated mutation testing in src/script/script.cpp. Covers edge cases in Pay-to-Taproot validation, Pay-to-Anchor parsing, SigOp counting boundaries, opcode bounds in HasValidOps, and truncated pushdata handling in CScript::GetOp. No source code logic is changed; only test coverage is added.
evidence: Targets eleven surviving mutants in `src/script/script.cpp` tracked on https://bitcoincore.space/public/mutation_data.json.
problem: Multiple boundary checks and validation logic paths in core script parsing and classification functions lacked explicit unit test coverage, leaving live mutants undetected by existing tests.

risk.why: Adds test assertions only; a mistake would result in test suite failures or false positives without impacting node runtime behavior.

scope_notes: Contains four clean, per-area test commits touching different unit test files (`script_segwit_tests.cpp`, `sigopcount_tests.cpp`, `script_standard_tests.cpp`, and `script_tests.cpp`).
summary: Adds unit tests across four script test suites to cover edge cases and boundary conditions in `src/script/script.cpp`. The additions target specific surviving mutants identified in automated mutation testing, covering `CScript::IsPayToTaproot`, `GetSigOpCount`, `IsPayToAnchor`, `HasValidOps`, `CScript::GetOp`, and `CScriptWitness::ToString`.
